name: Liang Yue
bio: Archetype: Empower Incantation, Extra Action. ⌽ Ult gives team [Immunity] and applies [Guardian's Resolve], which decreases DMG Taken. Summons Qiangliang for a few turns. ⌽ If Qiangliang is present, some rightmost cards gain +1 Rank when used and grant [Justice Talon], and some leftmost cards gain +1 turn to some effects' duration and grant [Peace Talon]. ⌽ At enough [Talon]s, triggers an AoE FUA whose effects depend on the proportion of each [Talon]. ⌽ Skill 1 generates [Justice Talon] and increases the duration of [Guardian's Resolve]. ⌽ Skill 2 generates [Peace Talon] and applies [Guardian's Blessing] to one ally: When attacked, Liang casts her S1 against the attacker.
